subject: How to add "label" and "groups" when using the plot.gm.prcomp function

messages.author: 0115fa6682bc8072
messages.subject: How to add "label" and "groups" when using the plot.gm.prcomp function
parts:
Dear all,

For the original plotTangentSpace function, one can easily add labels and groups to specimens by doing plotTangentSpace (x, label = label1, groups = group1).

For the updated plot.gm.prcomp function, is there any way to do the same thing? I found there is no argument within this function to do it directly.

Thank you very much!

Best,
Chi Zhang

messages.author: f16866fc42d43e64
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] How to add "label" and "groups" when using the plot.gm.prcomp function
parts:
Chi Zhang,

PCA tools for GM data are now included in the gm.prcomp function of geomorph. By plotting a gm.prcomp object you have available to you all arguments and tools of the R-base plot function.

Please see examples in vignette("geomorph.PCA") and in the help file of gm.prcomp.

Antigoni
